title: Align with format
description:
The same price-list row you built with stream manipulators in lesson 10.05 is one line with `std::format`.

Write `std::string row(std::string_view name, double price)`: the name left-aligned in 12 characters, the price right-aligned in 8 with two decimals.

| Spec | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `{:<12}` | left-align in a width of 12 |
| `{:>8.2f}` | right-align in 8, fixed, 2 decimals |

Then write `std::string centred(std::string_view text, int width)` that centres text in the given width, padding with `-` on both sides: `centred("hi", 8)` is `"---hi---"`. The width comes from an argument: `{:-^{}}`.
unitTests:
TEST("row") { CHECK_EQ(row("Coffee", 3.5), "Coffee          3.50"); CHECK_EQ(row("Sandwich", 12.0), "Sandwich       12.00"); }
TEST("centred") { CHECK_EQ(centred("hi", 8), "---hi---"); CHECK_EQ(centred("odd", 8), "--odd---"); CHECK_EQ(centred("too long", 3), "too long"); }
